title: In vivo passive lower-back bending stiffness, relaxation and energy dissipation in upright passive flexion (40 deg and 70% of range), by age group and sex
levels: lower back (T10-sacrum / leg-platform rotation about S1)
condition: passive flexion in upright frame (EMG monitored for no change)

quantity.name: average lower-back bending stiffness K = (Me - Ms)/(theta_e - theta_s)
quantity.definition: secant stiffness from the standing start point to 12.5, 25 and 100% of the target lower-back flexion; moment = harness-rod load-cell force x distance from harness to platform rotation axis (~S1); lower-back flexion = leg-platform rotation (pelvis/legs rotated about S1 with thorax fixed at T8); also relaxation moment (moment drop during 4-min hold), dissipated energy (loop area) and viscoelastic state

source.authors: Shojaei I, Allen-Bryant K, Bazrgari B
source.sample: 60 healthy adults in 5 gender-balanced age groups of 12 (22-28, 32-38, 42-48, 52-58, 62-68 y); youngest group M 25.6 y 177.8 cm 78.5 kg, F 23.5 y 164.9 cm 61.4 kg (Table 1)

protocol.summary: Rigid frame: pelvis strapped, thorax (T8) fixed by a harness-connecting rod with inline load cell; legs and pelvis rotated on an actuated platform about ~S1 at ~3 deg/s to 40 deg (test 1) or 70% of the subject's active lower-back flexion range (test 2), held 4 min, returned at the same speed. EMG of bilateral ES (L3, L5), RA and EO monitored. Two sessions averaged.
how_to_simulate: Upright model, thorax fixed at T8, pelvis and legs rotated together about an axis at S1 to impose lumbar flexion (no gravitational trunk moment change)
Set muscle activations to zero; flex to 40 deg (or 70% of the model's active range) at 3 deg/s

Compute the passive moment transmitted to the thorax constraint about the S1 axis and the secant stiffness from neutral to 5, 10 and 40 deg; compare with the youngest group (22-28 y) or the sex-specific values for a young adult model; viscoelastic models: also moment drop after 4 min

subject_model.source: Table 1, 22-28 y group (mean of M and F group means; derived)

protocol.notes: Stiffness values are secant (from upright) over 0-5, 0-10 and 0-40 deg. Nm/rad also given as Nm/deg (mean_Nm_per_deg, derived). Age-group relaxation and energy values (Figs 4, 6) not digitised. Same laboratory/apparatus as Toosizadeh 2012 (different participants).
